Methodology

This workspace does not invent live macro data. You set the observed regime, and IFIG converts it into a structured score. Use the existing Economic Calendar and CFTC tabs for live external inputs.

About IFIG
Nomonov Husniddin
Chief Executive Officer · Founder
Founder and CEO of International Financial Institution Group (IFIG), a global market-intelligence concept focused on professional cross-asset research, macro analysis, institutional positioning and disciplined risk frameworks.
@pwrcil — Telegram
GLOBAL MANDATE International Financial Intelligence

IFIG is designed as a cross-asset market intelligence environment for professional analysis across global equities, indices, FX, commodities, digital assets and macroeconomic regimes.

CONCEPT ORIGIN Since 2013

The core concept behind IFIG traces back to 2013: building one disciplined environment where global market data, research, positioning and risk frameworks can be viewed together.

PROFESSIONAL USE Built for Serious Market Participants

The platform is structured for institutional-style workflows, professional bank statement review, macro research, portfolio context, trading preparation and cross-market decision support.

PLATFORM PRINCIPLE Research Before Risk

IFIG combines market intelligence, fundamental analysis, technical context, positioning data, event risk and risk calculation into a single professional research workflow.
